answer_1.quote: We leveraged LLM GPT-4o to perform information augmentation, generating more detailed descriptions for these items... We also generated user reviews and merchant replies as textual outputs.
answer_1.outputs: User reviews, item descriptions, profile narratives, chain-of-thought reasoning texts

answer_2.quote: We compute evaluation metrics such as Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1 Score... We also report Adjusted Win Rate and use VADER sentiment analysis for review sentiment.

answer_3.quote: We adopted a pairwise evaluation strategy using a Judge Agent (GPT-4o). Each pair of samples from different method is evaluated twice with swapped order to reduce bias.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation study... Three human evaluators with expertise assessed which sample demonstrated more realistic behavioral logic and better alignment with the associated user profile.
answer_4.guideline: Assess which simulation sample shows more realistic behavioral logic and better alignment with the user profile.
